questions.question: The vetkoek-stall takings of R3 600 are shared in the ratio 4 : 3 : 2. What is the value of ONE part?
A recipe uses 400 g of sugar to 2 kg of flour. Written in simplest form, the ratio sugar : flour is:
A concrete mix uses cement : sand : stone in the ratio 2 : 3 : 4. For 36 wheelbarrows of mix, how many wheelbarrows of stone are needed?
Which statement about ratios is correct?
options: A ratio compares quantities of the same kind, in the same unit, and carries no unit itself
A ratio always carries a unit such as rand or kilogram
Swapping the order of the numbers in a ratio changes nothing
A ratio can only ever compare two quantities

subtopics.title: Rate — A Comparison That Carries Its Units

questions.question: A car travels 560 km on 40 litres of petrol. What is its fuel consumption?
The same car is driven 350 km. At R22,80 per litre, what does the petrol for the trip cost?
A minibus covers 54 km in 45 minutes. What is its average speed in km/h?
Water is charged at R16,80 per kilolitre. What does a household that uses 15 kℓ pay?
Five muffins cost R85,00. Using the unitary method, what do 9 muffins cost?
Six workers take 20 days to tile a hall. How many days would 8 workers take, working at the same rate?
Which test confirms that two quantities are in INDIRECT proportion?
options: Dividing one by the other always gives the same constant
Adding the pair always gives the same constant
Subtracting one from the other always gives zero
Multiplying the pair always gives the same constant

questions.question: A minibus costs a fixed R1 080 to hire. If 18 learners travel instead of 12, what happens to the cost per learner?
options: It rises from R60,00 to R90,00
It falls from R90,00 to R60,00
It stays at R90,00 because the hire price is fixed
It falls from R90,00 to R54,00

subtopics.title: Best Buy — Making the Comparison Fair

questions.question: A 2 kg bag of rice costs R56,99. What is the price per kilogram, rounded to the nearest cent?
The 10 kg bag costs R249,99. Which bag is the better buy, and by roughly how much per kilogram?
options: The 2 kg bag, by about R3,50 per kg
The 10 kg bag, by about R35,00 per kg
The 10 kg bag, by about R3,50 per kg
Neither — the price per kilogram is the same

questions.question: Which habit does the lesson name as the one that most often costs marks in a best-buy question?
options: Writing the answer as a full sentence
Rounding part-way through instead of only at the end
Showing the substitution on the page
Comparing the price of one kilogram in each bag

questions.question: Why might a shopper still choose the 2 kg bag even though it costs more per kilogram?
options: Because the price per kilogram is not a fair comparison
Because small bags always hold fresher rice
Because the ratio of the two prices is 2 : 10
Because she may not have R249,99 available today, or may lack sealed storage

questions.question: In the loaf analogy, what must you do FIRST before handing out any shares?
options: Cut the loaf into the total number of parts
Give the biggest slice to whoever asked first

questions.question: Sharing R3 600 in the ratio 4 : 3 : 2, the middle share is:
Which check does the Simplifier recommend at the end of every sharing question?
options: Add the shares back up and confirm they equal the original amount
Divide the largest share by the smallest
Round each share to the nearest R100

subtopics.title: What One Costs, What One Does

questions.question: In a rate, the word "per" means:
A car does 14 km per litre. How much petrol does a 350 km trip need?
Why can you not simply divide 54 km by 45 to get the minibus's speed in km/h?
options: Because 45 is in minutes, and an answer in km/h needs the time in hours
Because speed must be rounded to the nearest ten
Because the distance must first become metres

questions.question: What is the general rule the Simplifier gives for tariff-style costs?
options: Total price, divided by the rate
Price of one, plus how many
How many, divided by the price of one
Price of one, times how many

subtopics.title: More Hands, Fewer Days — and Finding the Real Price

questions.question: Six workers take 20 days. How does the Simplifier describe the size of the job?
A R1 080 minibus hire shared among 12 learners costs each of them:
Comparing a 2 kg bag at R56,99 with a 10 kg bag at R249,99, the fair comparison is:
options: the price of one kilogram in each case
the two shelf prices side by side
the mass difference between the bags

questions.question: Which final answer would a marker reward most fully?
options: "The 10 kg bag is the better buy at R25,00 per kg compared with R28,50 per kg, provided the shopper can afford R249,99 and store the rice sealed."
